- **PR #1** (`Add shared AppHeader shell component`) — merged (squash, branch deleted). Merge commit `74688aa1`.

- Added `.veri-icon-btn` to `tokens/globals.css`, exported `AppHeader` from `src/shell/index.ts`, updated README.
- `bunx tsc --noEmit` passed clean.
- No CI configured on this repo (no `.github/workflows`, no runs) — noted honestly rather than fabricating a wait.
- Tagged and pushed **v0.2.0** at the merge commit.
- `compliance-tracker` and PROJEXA were not touched — their migration to this component is separate, subsequent work.
